question: Which of the following dance forms is represented by Kelucharan Mohapatra?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra** is renowned for his contribution to the Indian classical dance form **Odissi**.
 
• He is credited with reviving, popularizing, and elevating Odissi to a prominent position among classical dance forms in India.
 
• Kelucharan Mohapatra has trained many notable Odissi dancers and has choreographed numerous acclaimed performances.
 
• His dedication and artistry have made him a legendary figure in the world of Indian classical dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi** is one of the eight classical dance forms of India and originates from the state of Odisha.
 
• This dance form is known for its fluid movements, intricate gestures, and expressive storytelling through dance.
 
• Odissi has a rich history that dates back to ancient times and has been depicted in the sculptures of temples in Odisha.
 
• The dance is performed to traditional Odissi music, which has its own unique rhythm and melody.
 
• Odissi performances often depict mythological stories, devotional themes, and classical literature.
